PROPOSED PROCEDURE FOR REHAB/RELOCATION ASSISTANCE
   Inspection by Rehab Technician. Preparation of Work Write-up and Cost Estimate.
2. Interview by Loan Advisors. Preparation of applications, etc.
3. Determination if Relocation Services are needed. 
a) <u>Temporary Relocation</u>  Rehab Specialist to complete Relocation

Services request form and route to Relocation Office upon agreement
with owner. / Proceed with routine rehab process.
b) <u>Permanent Relocation</u>  Rehab Specialist to review file with Rehab Technician to verify that rehabilitation of dwelling is not economically feasible. / Proceed with Item #4.
4. Senior Housing Sanitarian or Housing Sanitarian to certify that dwelling unit is recommended for demolition.
5. Rehab Staff upon agreement with property owner will proceed to institute house move-on procedures.
6. Rehab Specialist to refer case to Relocation Services using Relocation Services request for preliminary information regarding allowable housing replacement payment for applicant.
7. Rehab Staff, upon receipt of amount of allowed benefit, to prepare preliminary package showing estimate of costs for demolition of existing house; purchase and move on city owned house; and rehabilitation/landscaping.

Report to show source of funds, i.e., Housing Replacement Payment plus (CDBG or 312 or 235) funds.
8. Preliminary package to be submitted to loan committee for approval.
9. Rehab Staff to: 
a) Notify Relocation Office of loan approval
b) Request Relocation Office to process for Housing Replacement Payment
c) Request Relocation Office to place payment in an Escrow Account for CDBG loan client.
